properties.name: Seattle
properties.access: Guarded roads, ferries, and controlled airspace
properties.description: Seattle survived because it remained useful enough to save. Its brilliant corporate core is surrounded by districts preserved through municipal inertia, neighborhood cohesion, local power, or luck.

properties.name: Everett Bastion
properties.status: Everett municipality and northern industrial-defense hub
properties.known_for: Aerospace, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, port industry, and skilled trades
properties.access: I-5 commerce corridor, Paine industrial traffic, and Puget Sound port access
properties.description: Everett Bastion is not a sovereign city-state. It is an ordinary municipality whose identity is dominated by aerospace, defense manufacturing, private-security infrastructure, heavy fabrication, transport, worker housing, and the remains of older U.S. military infrastructure. Its visible patriotic culture sits uneasily beside the fact that corporations now control much of the industry once associated with national institutions.
properties.governance: Conventional Everett municipal government and services operating alongside powerful corporate employers
properties.communities: Industrial workers, veterans, skilled trades, aerospace staff, security contractors, transport crews, and their families
properties.organizations: AstraVail Technologies, Black Helix Security, municipal services, port contractors, and aerospace manufacturers
properties.connections: Competes for skilled labor while supplying aerospace, security, fabrication, and transport capacity across Puget Sound
properties.gm_notes: AstraVail Technologies and Black Helix Security are peers rather than territorial enemies; their strongest recurring rivalry is competition for skilled workers. Evelyn “Gauge” Mercer is a major local industrial fixer and a professional peer and friend of Mira “The Loom.” There is no organized anti-corporate uprising at campaign start.

properties.name: Tacoma
properties.status: Metahuman-led military republic in an armed cessation with Seattle
properties.known_for: Deepwater shipping, military service citizenship, logistics, and political independence
properties.access: The Port of Tacoma, through traffic on I-5, and a porous defensive zone near Fife and Milton
properties.governance: The Tacoma Ephorate, or the Five, divides authority among ground defense, harbor and naval forces, intelligence, logistics and infrastructure, and civil defense
properties.communities: Citizens who earned status through military service, non-citizen residents, veterans, port workers, and metahuman families
properties.organizations: Tacoma Ephorate, Black Helix, Empty Seats, and the port authorities
properties.connections: International deepwater trade, Black Helix convoy security, and guarded commerce with Seattle along I-5
properties.description: Tacoma is a de facto independent metahuman state organized around military service and control of the region's primary deepwater port. Seattle refuses formal recognition, but commerce and mutual dependence sustain an armed cessation rather than a peace treaty.
properties.gm_notes: First Ephor Sabine 'Breakwater' Okafor leads the Ephorate. Empty Seats includes peaceful and militant wings. Human Coalition Front remnants and the full political consequences of the Porter Way Bombing are GM-facing campaign material.

properties.name: Silicon Wilds
properties.status: Eastside frontier of independent settlements, ruins, and salvage zones
properties.known_for: Kirkland Downs, Badvue, Forgetown, Fool's End, overgrown campuses, AI remnants, and salvage
properties.access: Lake Washington ferries through Meridian, I-405 and SR-520 corridors, or hazardous northern approaches
properties.governance: No regional government; settlement councils, house compacts, entrepreneurs, and fortified local rulers govern their own territory
properties.communities: Fishing and agricultural enclaves, casino workers, salvagers, frontier traders, manufacturers, and fortified settlers
properties.organizations: Soundline Co-op, Crosswake Marine, Lucky Crossing, Badvue's house compact, and Marshal Tamsin Rook's Fool's End
properties.connections: Meridian ferries feed the Eastside; I-405 links Kirkland Downs, Badvue, and Forgetown; SR-520 runs toward Fool's End; the frontier fades east into Cascadia
properties.description: Strictly east of Lake Washington, the Silicon Wilds are a patchwork of surviving enclaves, abandoned towers, server vaults, salvage zones, frontier communities, and half-functioning systems. Mercer Island is culturally and operationally tied to the Wilds, though it lies outside the geographic boundary. The eastern edge has no hard line and gradually becomes Cascadia.
properties.gm_notes: Reports of 'Wessie' remain unresolved canon and should not be mapped as fact.

properties.name: Cascade Approaches
properties.status: Western gateway into Cascadia; authority fades by degrees rather than at a border
properties.known_for: First Nations stewardship, ordinary towns, independent settlements, locally maintained routes, and Resonance-altered ecology
properties.access: Increasingly unreliable eastbound roads and locally maintained routes beyond the metropolitan corridor
properties.description: The Cascade Approaches are the western gateway into Cascadia, not a synonym for Cascadia itself. Moving east, pavement degrades, maps and communications become less reliable, commercial networks thin out, infrastructure becomes locally maintained, metropolitan authority matters less, and forest and mountains increasingly dominate. GeoJSON can only sketch this transition; its north and south edges are not meaningful political boundaries.
properties.governance: No single regional government; First Nations exercise broad stewardship over ancestral territories alongside towns, settlements, homesteads, farms, and technical enclaves
properties.communities: First Nations communities, small towns, independent settlements, homesteads, agricultural communities, technical enclaves, guides, and route maintainers
properties.connections: Seattle and the Eastside fade west-to-east into the much larger cultural and geographic region of Cascadia
properties.gm_notes: Resonance-altered plants and animals are normal features of Cascadia; strange does not automatically mean broken. The Adventure 3 pattern of unusual aggression, emergent techno-organic structures, organic/artificial integration without implants, and continuing internal glow after death is abnormal and remains a current mystery. Selka’s Snoqualmie home village lies north of North Bend, has roughly 300–500 people, and must remain unmapped/private.
